title: aggmetrics: Aggregating Classification Performance Measures for Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: aggmetrics is a Python package that extends any binary performance measure expressed in the four confusion-matrix counts to multiclass, multilabel, ordinal, cost-sensitive, soft-label and cross-validation settings, by substituting one of four aggregation operators for what libraries usually expose as an average switch. The package also stores, for every measure, the structural properties that decide which identities apply to it, can infer those properties from a user-supplied formula, and uses them to warn when a measure is used where it does not behave as commonly assumed. Its test suite encodes the results of the companion theory as executable tests. The package is BSD-3 licensed, depends only on NumPy, and is available at https://github.com/rcprati/aggmetrics; documentation at https://aggmetrics.readthedocs.io.

translated_title: aggmetrics：面向机器学习的分类性能度量聚合
translated_abstract: aggmetrics 是一个 Python 包，它通过用四种聚合算子之一替代各类库中通常以“平均”开关形式暴露的功能，将任何以混淆矩阵四个计数表示的二分类性能度量扩展到多分类、多标签、序数、代价敏感、软标签以及交叉验证等设置。该包还为每个度量存储了决定哪些恒等式适用于该度量的结构性质，能够从用户提供的公式推断这些性质，并利用它们在度量被用于其行为不符合通常假设的场景时发出警告。其测试套件将配套理论的结果编码为可执行测试。该包采用 BSD-3 许可证，仅依赖 NumPy，可在 https://github.com/rcprati/aggmetrics 获取，文档见 https://aggmetrics.readthedocs.io。
tldr: aggmetrics 是一个仅依赖 NumPy 的 Python 包，通过四种聚合算子将任何基于混淆矩阵的二分类性能度量推广到多分类、多标签、序数、代价敏感、软标签和交叉验证等场景，并利用度量的结构性质在其使用不当时发出警告。
en_tdlr: aggmetrics is a Python package that generalizes any confusion-matrix-based binary performance measure to multiclass, multilabel, ordinal, cost-sensitive, soft-label and cross-validation settings via four aggregation operators, while leveraging measures' structural properties to warn against misuse.
